features.name: phenotype
features.description: The trait(s), disease(s), or condition(s) studied.

features.name: geographical_region
features.description: The geographic region(s) the study population is from.

features.name: ethnicity
features.description: The ethnicity/population descriptor of the participants as the authors describe it (e.g. 'Black South African').

features.name: mixed_population
features.description: true if the study sample combines participants from more than one distinct population/ethnicity/country; false if it is a single population. Absent if the text does not make this determinable.

features.name: origin
features.description: The country or countries the participants are from (participant ancestry/recruitment origin, NOT the institution's location if different).
